The '''Farwatcher''' was one of nine interstellar probes launched by the [[Pre-Lament Civilization]] in the time before the [[Etheric Sea]] enveloped Solaris during the first [[The Lament|Lament]] 10,000 years ago. Although it had been continuously transmitting information of the galaxies it travelled through back to Solaris for millennia, as the Etheric Sea blocks all contact between Solaris and the outside world, these signals failed to reach their creators.

The [[Exostrider]] would later pick up on these signals, recording them and burning them into a cassette which would be gifted to [[Rover]] and the people of Lahai-Roi during ''[[Starlights from Yesterdays]]''.

As one of the nine interstellar probes launched in ancient humanity's spacefaring era, the Farwatcher is represented as one of the nine stars in the logo of the [[Spacetrek Collective]].
